name: reset
js: (() => { try { localStorage.clear(); } catch (e) {} setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 50); return 'reloading'; })()

name: closeSetup
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('setupDialog'); if (d && d.close) d.close(); return [!!d, typeof GMMCSim]; })()

name: geoFit
js: (() => { GMMC.setLayout('geographic'); GMMC.fit(); return GMMC.getMap().lines.filter(l => l.visible).length + ' visible lines'; })()

name: start
js: (() => { document.getElementById('simBtn').click(); const s = GMMCSim.state(); return [s.on, s.clock, s.band, s.total, Object.keys(s.lines).length, !document.getElementById('simBar').hidden]; })()

name: perLine
js: (() => { const s = GMMCSim.state(); return Object.entries(s.lines).slice(0, 14).map(([id, l]) => l.name + ': hw ' + l.headwayMin + ' min, one-way ' + l.oneWayMin + ' min, ' + l.lengthKm + ' km, ' + l.vehicles + ' vehicles, expected ' + 2 * Math.ceil(l.oneWayMin / l.headwayMin)); })()

name: consistency
js: (() => { const s = GMMCSim.state(); const bad = Object.values(s.lines).filter(l => l.vehicles !== 2 * Math.ceil(l.oneWayMin / l.headwayMin)); return ['mismatches', bad.length, bad.slice(0, 3), 'total', s.total, 'bar text', document.getElementById('simCount').textContent]; })()

name: viva
js: (() => { const s = GMMCSim.state(); const e = Object.values(s.lines).find(l => /Viva Blue/i.test(l.name)); return e || 'no Viva Blue'; })()

name: speed10
js: (() => { GMMCSim.setSpeed(10); const a = GMMCSim.state().seconds; return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const b = GMMCSim.state().seconds; r(['10x: sim seconds in 2 real s', +(b - a).toFixed(1)]); }, 2000)); })()

name: speed60
js: (() => { document.querySelector('[data-speed="60"]').click(); const a = GMMCSim.state().seconds; return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const b = GMMCSim.state().seconds; r(['60x: sim seconds in 2 real s', +(b - a).toFixed(1), GMMCSim.state().speed]); }, 2000)); })()

name: speed1
js: (() => { document.querySelector('[data-speed="1"]').click(); const a = GMMCSim.state().seconds; return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const b = GMMCSim.state().seconds; r(['1x: sim seconds in 2 real s', +(b - a).toFixed(1)]); }, 2000)); })()

name: setClock
js: (() => { GMMCSim.setSpeed(60); GMMCSim.setClock('08:14'); const s = GMMCSim.state(); return [s.clock, s.band, s.total, document.getElementById('simBand').textContent]; })()

name: pixelSnapshot
js: (() => { const c = document.getElementById('simCanvas'); const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0, h = 0; for (let i = 3; i < d.length; i += 4) { if (d[i]) n++; } for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 101) h = (h * 31 + d[i]) | 0; window.__h1 = h; window.__a = GMMCSim.state().seconds; return ['non-transparent px', n, 'canvas', c.width + 'x' + c.height, 'hash', h]; })()

name: pixelSnapshot2
js: (() => { const c = document.getElementById('simCanvas'); const d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let h = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 101) h = (h * 31 + d[i]) | 0; return ['hash', window.__h1, '->', h, 'moved', h !== window.__h1, 'sim seconds advanced', +(GMMCSim.state().seconds - window.__a).toFixed(1)]; })()

name: pause
js: (() => { document.getElementById('simPlay').click(); const a = GMMCSim.state().seconds; return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => r(['paused', !GMMCSim.state().playing, 'delta', GMMCSim.state().seconds - a]), 800)); })()

name: play
js: (() => { document.getElementById('simPlay').click(); return GMMCSim.state().playing; })()

name: reduced
js: (() => { GMMCSim.setReducedMotion(true); const a = GMMCSim.state().seconds; return new Promise(r => setTimeout(() => { const b = GMMCSim.state().seconds; const stepVisible = !document.getElementById('simStep').hidden; document.getElementById('simStep').click(); r(['reduced: delta without step', b - a, 'step button visible', stepVisible, 'after step click', +(GMMCSim.state().seconds - b).toFixed(1)]); }, 1000)); })()

name: unreduce
js: (() => { GMMCSim.setReducedMotion(null); return GMMCSim.state().reducedMotion; })()

name: schematic
js: (() => { GMMC.setLayout('schematic'); GMMC.fit(); GMMCSim.setClock('08:14'); GMMCSim.setSpeed(10); const s = GMMCSim.state(); return ['schematic total', s.total, Object.keys(s.lines).length]; })()

name: recordClip
js: (async () => { try { const r = await GMMCSim.record({ seconds: 3, download: false, toast: false }); return ['clip bytes', r.bytes, r.type, 'frames', r.frames, r.width + 'x' + r.height]; } catch (e) { return 'record failed: ' + (e && e.message); } })()

name: keyP
js: (() => { document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'p', bubbles: true })); const a = GMMCSim.state().on; document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'p', bubbles: true })); return ['after P', a, 'after second P', GMMCSim.state().on]; })()

name: stop
js: (() => { GMMCSim.stop(); return [GMMCSim.state().on, document.getElementById('simBar').hidden, document.getElementById('simCanvas').hidden]; })()
